---
title: "Quality of Life Estimands"
---

## Setup

```{r}
#| output: false
library(fs)
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
library(data.table)
library(ggdist)
library(patchwork)
library(duckdb)
```

## Read marginalized SOPs

Loop over all imputations and combine the SOPs.

```{r}
# Directory containing the SOPs
sop_dir <- here("0-main-analysis", "QOL", "results", "sops")

# Create a temporary on-disk database
db_path <- here(sop_dir, "qol-sens-1-scratch.duckdb")
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = db_path)

# Get number of imputations
m <- length(list.dirs(sop_dir, full.names = FALSE, recursive = FALSE)[grep("^imp_", list.dirs(sop_dir, full.names = FALSE, recursive = FALSE))])

# Prepare list of all file patterns and metadata for DuckDB to read directly
queries <- character()
for (imp_idx in 1:m) {
  # Use glob patterns - DuckDB reads all matching files at once
  dir_0 <- normalizePath(here(sop_dir, glue::glue("imp_{imp_idx}"), "marginalized_sop_0"), winslash = "/")
  dir_1 <- normalizePath(here(sop_dir, glue::glue("imp_{imp_idx}"), "marginalized_sop_1"), winslash = "/")

  queries <- c(queries,
    glue::glue("SELECT state, time, draw, 0 as tx, {imp_idx} as imp, sop FROM read_parquet('{dir_0}/*.parquet')"),
    glue::glue("SELECT state, time, draw, 1 as tx, {imp_idx} as imp, sop FROM read_parquet('{dir_1}/*.parquet')")
  )
}

# Read all parquets and aggregate in one pass
full_query <- glue::glue("
  WITH all_data AS (
    {paste(queries, collapse = '\n    UNION ALL\n    ')}
  )
  SELECT
    state,
    time,
    draw,
    tx,
    imp,
    AVG(sop) as sop
  FROM all_data
  GROUP BY state, time, draw, tx, imp
")

message("Processing all imputations with DuckDB...")
sop_summary <- dbGetQuery(con, full_query) |> as_tibble()

# Clean up
dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
duckdb::duckdb_shutdown(duckdb::duckdb())  # Fully release file locks
if (file.exists(db_path)) file.remove(db_path)

# Format for plotting
setDT(sop_summary)
sop_summary[, state := as.factor(state)]
sop_summary[, tx := factor(tx, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("UC", "SAT"))]

write_parquet(sop_summary, here(sop_dir, "sop_combined.parquet"))
rm(sop_summary)
```

## Plotting

### Marginalized SOPs

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6
fig_marginalized <-
  read_parquet(here(sop_dir, "sop_combined.parquet")) |>
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = time, y = sop) +
  stat_lineribbon(
    aes(fill = state, linetype = tx),
    linewidth = 0.6,
    alpha = 0.4,
    .width = 0.95
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 26, by = 4)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 0.5)) +
  labs(
    x = "Study Week",
    y = "SOP",
    subtitle = "Marginalized state occupancy probabilities",
    fill = "State",
    linetype = "Group"
  )
ggsave(
  here("0-main-analysis", "img", "qol_marginalized_sops.svg"),
  plot = fig_marginalized,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```

### Grouped SOPs

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6
fig_marginalized_grouped <-
  open_dataset(here(sop_dir, "sop_combined.parquet")) |>
  mutate(group = case_when(
    state == "1" | state == "2" | state == "3" ~ "Good",
    state == "7" | state == "6" | state == "5" ~ "Bad",
    state == "8" ~ "Dead",
    TRUE ~ "Average")) |>
  group_by(group, draw, tx, time, imp) |>
  summarise(sop = sum(sop), .groups = "drop") |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = c("Good", "Average", "Bad", "Dead"))
  ) |>
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = time, y = sop) +
  stat_lineribbon(
    aes(fill = group, linetype = tx),
    linewidth = 0.6,
    alpha = 0.5,
    .width = c(0.95)
  ) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2", guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 26, by = 4)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Study Week",
    y = "SOP",
    subtitle = "Marginalized state occupancy probabilities",
    fill = "State",
    linetype = "Group"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")



ggsave(
  here("0-main-analysis", "img", "qol_grouped_sops.svg"),
  plot = fig_marginalized_grouped,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```

## Primary Estimand

### Difference in Weeks with >= Good Quality of Life

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5

# Marginalized difference in weeks for >= good QoL
posterior <- open_dataset(here(sop_dir, "sop_combined.parquet")) |>
  filter(state == "1" | state == "2" | state == "3") |>
  group_by(tx, draw, imp) |>
  summarise(mean_weeks = sum(sop), .groups = "drop") |>
  collect() |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = tx, values_from = mean_weeks, names_prefix = "tx_") |>
  mutate(difference = tx_SAT - tx_UC)

# Summary statistics
posterior_summary <- posterior |>
  summarise(
    mean = mean(difference),
    median = median(difference),
    sd = sd(difference),
    q025 = quantile(difference, 0.025),
    q975 = quantile(difference, 0.975),
    p_benefit = mean(difference > 0)
  )

posterior_summary
```

### Posterior Distribution Plot

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5

plot_posterior <- posterior |>
  ggplot(aes(x = difference)) +
  stat_dots(side = "bottom") +
  stat_halfeye() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    x = bquote(paste("Treatment Difference in Weeks spent with ", "" >= "", " Good Quality of Life (SAT - UC)")),
    y = "Density"
  )


ggsave(
  here("0-main-analysis", "img", "qol_posterior_distribution.svg"),
  plot = plot_posterior,
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
```
